scripts.build: export STRIPES_TRANSPILE_TOKENS="@k-int @projectreshare"; export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096 $NODE_OPTIONS"; stripes build stripes.config.js
scripts.buildconsortial: export STRIPES_TRANSPILE_TOKENS="@k-int @projectreshare"; export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096 $NODE_OPTIONS"; stripes build consortial.stripes.config.js
scripts.deploy: sh -c 'find $0 -type f -exec gzip "{}" \; -exec mv "{}.gz" "{}" \; ; aws --profile indexdata-dev s3 sync ${0}/ s3://reshare-bundles/${0} --acl public-read --content-encoding gzip --delete'
scripts.upload: sh -c 'aws --profile indexdata-dev s3 sync ${0}/ s3://reshare-bundles/${0} --acl public-read --content-encoding gzip --delete'
